title: Innovative Solutions for Higher Efficiency and Throughput in Cryo-Electron Microscopy and Tomography
content: Cryo-electron microscopy (cryo-EM) and single-particle analysis (SPA) have revolutionized structural biology, enabling high-resolution visualization of macromolecular complexes with unprecedented detail. As this technique continues to push the boundaries of atomic-resolution imaging, cryo-electron tomography (cryo-ET) emerges at the interface of structural and cell biology, offering up to near-atomic resolution views of macromolecules in their native cellular environments. Cryo-TEM instrumentation from Thermo Fisher Scientific has been at the forefront of many breakthroughs, including the resolution revolution and the ongoing popularization of cryo-ET.
